new.title: intermittent failures of the shell suite. ROOT CAUSE: SIGPIPE under pipefail. `producer | grep -q` (or `| awk ... exit`, `| head`) makes the consumer exit at its first match; a producer that writes more than one chunk is killed with SIGPIPE and, with pipefail (+set -e), the pipeline reports 141 although the pattern WAS found. Reproduced on a static 10.7 KB file: 14/6000 wrong answers (here-string form 0/6000; 200-byte control 0/6000). It also hit PRODUCTION code: preflight.sh `sshd -T | awk ... exit` (SSH-port detection that gates firewall activation), install.sh's REALITY decoy TLS probe, my own ssh-harden.sh effective() (aborted AFTER writing the drop-in).
new.fix: 306 echo/printf/cat|grep sites rewritten to here-strings (quote-aware, validated by bash -n, shellcheck and the suite); early-exit awk/head/sed/read after real commands get `|| true`; deploy/lib/lint_pipefail_pipes.py (rules R1-R3, reviewed allowlist) + CI-run guard test
new.regression_test: deploy/lib/tests/test-no-pipefail-sigpipe-race.sh (lint must be clean AND must detect 5 bad forms); test-ssh-harden.sh BIGOUT cases (red on the old code); controlled experiment: original tree under identical CPU load failed test-ssh-harden in 3/3 iterations, fixed tree 0 failures (see evidence/i53)
new.remaining_risk: the lint cannot see every producer (a quoted `"$x/cmd" | grep -q` can still race); a retry-pass is now reported as FLAKY and exits 3 so it never counts as clean
new.evidence: evidence/i53: idle original tree failed ssh-harden in 2 of 6 iterations; loaded original 3/3; loaded fixed see summary

carried.note: rc2 R2: baseline origin/main fresh install records no public_ipv4/6 and a tunnel user reads the node's sshd banner and nginx; candidate fresh install records both, doctor C-16 OK, same tunnel test refused (rc 35 / rc 52), internet still 204; survives reboot. carried.evidence_2026_10_20: re-running install.sh on a dev install used the new source tree (the vhost template fix, absent from the old tree, was applied; evidence/lifecycle/).
carried.title: Dev-channel installer over an existing install reuses the old source tree and records version 'main'
carried.note: rc2 R2: reproduced on origin/main logic (requested main over a candidate tree: 'reusing the existing root-controlled persistent source tree', candidate binaries kept, success reported, manifest 'main'). Fix: persistent tree reused only if its content digest equals the request, else staged, verified and swapped by two renames with crash recovery; bootstrap accepts a full commit SHA and refuses an archive whose commit differs; manifest records source_ref/source_commit/source_tree_sha256. Verified on the box: crash between renames recovered, failed install after a swap converges on re-run. Caveat: the fix protects installs of refs that contain it; an older ref's installer still reuses the tree Released in v1.3.1-rc.2 (prerelease, tag on merge commit d64ea56).

carried.title: v1.3.1-rc.1's updater rollback fails ('UPDATE FAILED - ROLLBACK ALSO FAILED') when sing-box restarts are close together: the rollback restart hits StartLimitBurst
carried.note: rc2 R3: rc.1 -> rc.2 with an injected failure right after 5 user operations: files restored byte-identically but sing-box left in start-limit-hit and vpn-expiry-reconcile failed; recovered by reset-failed. Same update on a clear restart budget: restored and verified. rc.2's own updater, after 34 starts in 3 minutes: restored and verified, no start-limit event. Root cause is I-11, fixed in rc.2; hosts still on rc.1 keep the rc.1 updater for the rc.1 -> rc.2 step, so avoid user changes in the minutes before it.
